name: Kodak T-Max 400
notes: B&W single-layer path (pan curve + 1x3 panchromatic weights + identity DIR), following the Tri-X 400 file's conventions. H&D approx from memory of the Kodak T-Max 400 (TMY-2) datasheet characteristic curve for D-76; straight-line gamma ~0.62, slightly more linear toe-to-shoulder than Tri-X (T-grain's straighter curve). logE = 0 at the ISO speed point with density 0.15 above fog for engine consistency. Diffuse RMS Granularity 10 is from the Kodak T-Max 400 datasheet (vs Tri-X's 17 - the T-grain fine-grain signature), grain pitch 2.0 px engine-derived (tighter than Tri-X's 3.4). ESTIMATED: panchromatic weights (TMY-2's extended, more even pan sensitivity vs Tri-X - slightly more red, less green weight), halation (modern AH layer, subtle, no red dye glow so green_fraction 0), base fog, print paper (grade ~2-3 silver-gelatin, same aim as Tri-X). Grain keys flattened for the engine (nested pan block is a documentation mirror). No local T-Max scans. Memory approximation. 2026-07-11
